perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Q2 evidence showed 48% revenue growth to $23.0 billion driven primarily by Mounjaro and Zepbound volume, alongside higher full-year guidance.
The 2026-09-18 FDA approval of Inluriyo with Verzenio adds realized oncology regulatory execution outside the incretin franchise.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: FDA approval is realized execution but does not establish material uptake, payer coverage, market share or margin.
Exceptional incretin volume/revenue momentum coexists with meaningful realized-price compression; both signals remain active and should not be collapsed into a one-direction narrative.

contradictions: Strong volume/revenue momentum coexists with realized-price compression.
